identification: Qashqai (Fars, south-west Iran) slit-tapestry flatweave kilim, 280 x 135 cm (about 9'2" x 4'5", long rug / wide runner): three stacked concentric serrated diamond medallions on a madder-red field filled with rows of small triangles in gold, olive green, aubergine/black and orange, narrow yellow sawtooth outer border with overcast selvedges, wool. Colour shows abrash and soft vegetal-type tones and the ends look slightly worn, so it reads as a vintage piece (perhaps 1960s-1980s) rather than brand-new stock, despite the dealer studio photos. Catalogue: 100% wool, natural dyes, documentation of authenticity (#380), so a rug dealer's consignment.

viewing_check: Check the back: even colour front and back (natural dyes fade only on the front), no moth trails in the black/dark wool (aubergine/black dyes rot first), slits intact, ends and selvedges not unravelling. Read the #380 authenticity document (dealer name, age claimed).
